items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: obviously I’m doing things with my family, you know, Marlon and my sister Stephanie and Rachel, we’re doing some things and so hopefully we’ll be up here soon doing that

ctx.x: Well I hope you play an important role in all that. And I have a feeling you will somehow or other.

Yeah. Well what’s new for me and I’ll just put this in the archive, I’m trying to actually work on my flute and strings project, I’d like to put that out there again. And it something that it’s really been a while since I’ve done it and obviously I’m doing things with my family, you know, Marlon and my sister Stephanie and Rachel, we’re doing some things and so hopefully we’ll be up here soon doing that.
Well it’s been a great time for me to have this conversation with you, I appreciate it.
